    - comment blocks:
      - @1.95s, 2% down: "You can record incoming OSC messages in the timeline by slecting them in the device explorer, / and then right-clicking in a Scenario and selecting one of the recording options. / There are two modes: / - Record automations uses automation curves, and is better for free-flowing / streaming messages such as sensor input, etc. / - Record messages writes in scenario states and is better for infrequent messages. / Future versions will improve this by allowing to pick the correct type of proceess to use depending on the message kind, / and generally improve the recording workflow: / feature requests are welcome at https://github.com/orgs/ossia/projects/39 / In this case, we assume that sensors2OSC android app is installed and streaming to this score."
      - @2.09s, 17% down: "The settings have some controls: for instance, how much data get smoothed out when recording. / Here are some examples showcasing the results."
      - @11.95s, 41% down: "Recording automations has two modes: / ramp to new value or not. / It chooses whether we care more about having / a smooth, ramping signal, or something that / matches more closely the actual messages we received."
      - @12.01s, 17% down: "Note that in every case, recording starts on the / first received message."
